verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!

xrefs.text: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.
But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

verses.text: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

xrefs.text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.

He says: “It is not enough for You to be My Servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the protected ones of Israel. I will also make You a light for the nations, to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth.”

verses.text: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.

xrefs.text: Then he took the crown from the head of their king. It weighed a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.

Then David took the crown from the head of their king. It was found to weigh a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!

verses.text: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.

xrefs.text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.

verses.text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.

xrefs.text: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

verses.text: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

xrefs.text: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.

verses.text: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

xrefs.text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

And He was given dominion, glory, and kingship, that the people of every nation and language should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.

verses.text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.

xrefs.text: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.
A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.

verses.text: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

xrefs.text: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.

verses.text: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.

xrefs.text: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
And this was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its extermination and destruction from the face of the earth.
The possessions of his house will be removed, flowing away on the day of God’s wrath.
You will not join them in burial, since you have destroyed your land and slaughtered your own people. The offspring of the wicked will never again be mentioned.
May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.

verses.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.

xrefs.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.
For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
‘Let us invade Judah, terrorize it, and divide it among ourselves. Then we can install the son of Tabeal over it as king.’

verses.text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.

xrefs.text: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;

verses.text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.

xrefs.text: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
